multipleIndependentFloodEvents.explanation: 32 independently identified event groups are represented.

positivesAcrossMultipleEventGroups.explanation: Canonical positives occur in 31 event groups.

defensibleNegatives.explanation: 26911 negatives meet source/clear coverage and permanent-water rules and have flood exposure <= 0.001.

usableClassBalance.explanation: Natural usable support is 2219 positive and 26911 negative (7.6176% positive); unknowns were not converted to negatives.

multipleGeographicGroups.explanation: Canonical positives occur in 13 GAUL level-2 regions.

eventTemporalSeparationPossible.explanation: Positive events span 2002-2016 across 14 distinct years, permitting later-event validation.

geographicSeparationPossible.explanation: 13 positive-support regions permit entire-region holdout without row splitting.

meaningfulTargetAtSourceResolution.explanation: The target remains ~250 m road-corridor flood exposure, explicitly not closure, depth, passability, or pavement truth.

preEventStaticFeaturesAvailable.explanation: OSM road class, length, directionality, and geometry-derived features are local and static; causal history can be computed using only earlier events.

meaningfulEvaluationBeyondLookupPossible.explanation: Many positive event and geographic groups support later-event validation and unseen-region testing without feeding region identity to the model.

noObviousLeakage.explanation: Same-event flood fraction, quality masks, event duration/severity, region identity, and post-event impact are prohibited as model inputs.

decision: Proceed to non-leaky feature construction, grouped temporal/geographic evaluation, Logistic Regression, and Random Forest. Runtime replacement remains conditional on valid evaluation.
selectionAudit: Criteria fixed before OSM extraction or road-corridor labels.
